prompt: Why should Musical Bots win the Meta Global AI Hackathon?
title: Why Should We Win
irony: The doubt the bots dare to sing aloud, that a singing cartoon can compete, is itself the proof that no one else sings its own work.
facts: The hackathon is online, for up to twenty thousand builders from around the world (dev.meta.ai).
It began Oct 26 with a kickoff livestream (dev.meta.ai).
Live workshops and office hours run until Nov 4, and projects are due Nov 4 (dev.meta.ai).
Musical Bots enters the Indie developer track for individual builders (dev.meta.ai).
Its judges look for three things: creativity, technical ambition, and whether it works (dev.meta.ai).
Judging runs Nov 4 to Nov 8, and winners are announced at the closing ceremony on Nov 9 (fact sheet).
One finished minute of studio 3D cartoon costs about five thousand dollars, four minutes about twenty thousand (fact sheet).
Musical Bots makes a whole four-minute song for about ten cents of AI time, in about ten minutes (fact sheet).
By noon on Nov 1 the builder holds 224 commits since Oct 28, with 33 between midnight and six on three nights (git log).
At 4:19 in the morning on Nov 1 Black joins the crew as the plot's trouble (git log).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning light fills Gold's diner; Green, Navy and Gold gather round the table with one laptop.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green pitches sing-alongs for little kids for Meta's judges, then corrects Gold's figures, scared of the big contest.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black scrolls a long list of almost eight hundred clever entries; Green hears their own work singing too and accepts the doubt.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew chants the question hook; one line sings they sing their work as they make it, one a whole song for a dime.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black asks who needs our song; White sings chord choices, Green tries lines, the gate stamps no.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Past midnight the laptop glows on the night street; the team yawns, runs the Muse crew and re-writes songs till sunrise.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Under the streetlamp the crew sings the same hook, work sung as made, a whole song for a dime.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold counts the sums at the market stall: one studio minute costs thousands, their whole song about ten cents, browsers sing free.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides they sing their doubt aloud and show every choice, mums and teachers hearing all the work.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: On the diner stage Gold turns the chant: no one else sings its work, we do, we Musical Bots, that is why we should win.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Morning light fills Gold's diner again; all chant the question, then sing Musical Bots together on the stage.
